About Invesco 
 
 As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
 
 
 What’s in it for you? 
 

 Our people are at the ver y core of our success. Invesco employees get more out of life through our comprehensive compensation and benefit offerings including:   

 Flexible paid time off 

 Hybrid work schedule  

 401(K) matching of 100% up to the first 6% with a discretionary supplemental contribution  

 Health & wellbeing benefits  

 Parental Leave benefits  

 Employee stock purchase plan 

 

 
 
 Job Description 
 


 About the Team: 
 The Strategy, Innovation & Planning (SIP) team serves as Invesco’s central AI hub, focused on advancing innovation and delivering impactful AI solutions across the firm. Our team is focused on rapid experimentation using new AI tools and technologies to solve business problems. We are focused on using various agentic frameworks and building business-sponsored GenAI use cases that drive operational efficiency. Beyond product development, SIP actively fosters AI adoption across Invesco through initiatives such as AI/ML Meetups, hackathons, and cross-team collaborations.
 
 About the Role: 
 As Software Engineer on the SIP team, you will help design, build, and scale next-generation AI applications that solve complex business problems. You will work in a highly collaborative, agile environment with a startup mindset—focused on rapid experimentation, continuous learning, and hands-on engineering. This role is designed for a creative technologist who views AI tools (like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or LLM APIs) or Agentic Frameworks (Microsoft Copilot Studio, AgentCore/Strands, LangGraph etc.) as fundamental to their workflow, enabling them to contribute directly to the future of AI at Invesco.
 
 Responsibilities of the Role: 
 Collaborating with data scientists, data engineers, and investment professionals to build innovative AI-based tools using structured and alternate data sources.

 Rapidly prototyping new and innovative solutions alongside experienced developers, using AI-assisted coding to accelerate the "idea-to-MVP" cycle.

 Developing and refining Invesco’s Generative AI platform by creating system prompts, implementing agentic workflows and LLM-integrated features.

 Coding and delivering cloud-native microservices and micro-UI components that integrate seamlessly with AI orchestration layers.

 Building validations, evaluations and guardrails on selected agent frameworks for custom agents built for various business use cases

 Applying "AI-first" engineering principles to find creative solutions to the unique architectural challenges encountered when scaling agentic systems.

 Working at speed to show measurable value per sprint, maintaining high code quality through modern automation and testing.

 
 
 Requirements of the Role: 
 Creative Problem Solver: 0–2 years of experience with a portfolio of projects (professional or personal) that demonstrate an ability to build functional, creative web applications.

 Modern Tech Stack: Foundational proficiency in Python (for AI/Backend) and TypeScript/React (for Frontend).

 AI Native Workflow: High level of comfort using AI coding assistants and LLMs to debug, document, and write boilerplate code efficiently.

 Architectural Curiosity: Exposure to (or a strong desire to learn) LangGraph, LangChain, and agentic design patterns.

 Cloud & DevOps Foundations: Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker), Git version control, and basic cloud concepts (AWS or Azure).

 Agile Mindset: A proactive learner who thrives in a fast-paced, value-driven environment and is comfortable experimenting with emerging technologies.

 
 Full Time / Part Time 
 
Full time 
 Worker Type 
 
Employee 
 Job Exempt (Yes / No) 
 
Yes 
 Workplace Model 
 
 Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in an Invesco office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development. 
 
 The above information on this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. The job holder may be required to perform other duties as deemed appropriate by their manager from time to time. 
 
 Invesco's culture of inclusivity and its commitment to diversity in the workplace are demonstrated through our people practices. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, citizenship status, disability, age, or veteran status. Our equal opportunity employment efforts comply with all applicable U.S. state and federal laws governing non-discrimination in employment.
